Independent FAQ · reviewed 15 September 2026

Clear workflow answers. No inflated claims.

These answers reflect the public LoloBuy workflow and help-centre topics. Policies, routes and eligibility can change; verify the live account details before paying.

Is this an official LoloBuy website?

No. This is an independent discovery and research guide. It does not represent LoloBuy, marketplace sellers or carriers.

What is the basic LoloBuy process?

The public workflow presents a sequence of product-link purchase, domestic delivery to a warehouse, QC evidence, parcel submission and international shipping. Each stage has separate information to check.

Do QC photos guarantee an item’s quality or authenticity?

No. QC photos can help show a received item’s visible condition, option, label, count or measurement, but lighting, framing and image quality have limits. They are evidence for a decision, not a guarantee.

Can I assume every product can use every shipping route?

No. Route availability can depend on destination, actual or volumetric weight, dimensions and item restrictions. Check the live route screen and destination-specific rules before submitting a parcel.

Can this site quote final freight, customs, tax or delivery time?

No. Those outcomes depend on live parcel details, selected route and destination requirements. This site does not provide carrier guarantees or customs advice.

When should I consider a return or refund?

First compare the warehouse evidence with the saved listing and your chosen option. Current eligibility can depend on seller terms, item condition and time limits, so review the live return/refund process before dispatching internationally.

What does a tracking event mean?

A scan records an event in a carrier process. It does not by itself promise customs clearance or delivery on a specific date. Check the latest timestamp and wording in the relevant account.

Where does the search box go?

Every search form on this research site opens matching live results in FindSpreadsheet. The database helps you shortlist products; listing and parcel checks remain your responsibility.
